links.comparator_used: No validator baseline (reasoner only); also KG validation without context matching
links.outcome: Medical QA accuracy on KG-grounded MedReason subset (2,788 questions), Haiku-4.5 as Reasoner and Validator
links.effect: KG-backed validation +0.61 pp over no-validator baseline; QKG with context matching +0.79 pp over KG validation without context matching and +1.40 pp over no-validator baseline (paired McNemar, all p<0.05). With stronger validator (Qwen-3.6-Plus), raw QKG gain over no-validator baseline +5.96 pp; context-matching gap p=0.73 on raw set, p=0.05 after adjustment.
links.quote: With Haiku-4.5 as both the Reasoner and the Validator, KG-backed validation significantly improves over a no-validator baseline ($+0.61$ pp), and QKG with context matching yields the largest gain, outperforming both KG validation without context matching ($+0.79$ pp) and the no-validator baseline ($+1.40$ pp; paired McNemar, all $p<0.05$).

links.comparator_used: No-validator baseline (reasoner output released without KG-based validation)
links.outcome: Medical QA accuracy on KG-grounded MedReason subset (2,788 questions)
links.effect: KG-backed validation +0.61 pp over no-validator baseline; QKG with context matching +1.40 pp over baseline (p<0.05); with Qwen-3.6-Plus validator, raw QKG gain grew from +1.40 pp to +5.96 pp.
links.quote: Under a stronger validator (Qwen-3.6-Plus), the raw QKG gain over the no-validator baseline grows from $+1.40$ pp to $+5.96$ pp; the context-matching gap is non-significant ($p=0.73$) on the raw set but becomes borderline significant ($p=0.05$) after adjustment for knowledge leakage and suspicious questions, consistent with a benchmark-gold ceiling rather than a QKG limitation.

design_hint: knowledge graph-based validation with context matching (retrieval grounding)
